build_wide_resnet_model: build a Wide_ResNet model with specified depth, widen factor, dropout rate, and number of classes
create_wide_basic_block: create a wide_basic residual block with batch norm, conv layers, dropout, and shortcut connection
run_conv3x3: run conv3x3 to create a 3x3 convolutional layer with specified input and output planes
test_conv_init: test conv_init to apply Xavier uniform weight initialization and constant bias to conv and batch norm layers
review_wide_resnet_forward: review the Wide_ResNet forward pass that processes input through conv, three layers, batch norm, pooling, and linear output
